cause: The implementation incorrectly used an absolute historical raw-logit replay tolerance as a gate for the R1.4 paired intervention. Train-mode sparse-backbone numerical variation is present even for two native forwards with identical parameters, buffers and RNG. A shared actual initial graph now enforces the required paired forward invariance exactly.
historical_check_role: Numerical-reproduction audit, not an exclusion criterion for a scientific source batch. No repeated attempts to obtain a passing maximum error.
paired_experiment_gates: Same checkpoint parameters and Adam state for every arm
Fixed point cloud, queries, sampled directions and previously frozen labels
Historical full and decoded A/D argmax classes unchanged
Same-backbone downstream logits and raw loss exactly equal
Shared step1 full-network gradients with unchanged A/D/Q output-layer gradients
Original historical heldout TF32 geometry exactly equal
Unchanged direct analytic feasibility, collision and empty-grasp criteria

scene64.reconstruction: Reconstruct the common initial graph once under the clarified rule, record all logits/gradients and both old and new checks. Do not describe this as reuse of the first graph or retry until numerical success.

remaining_scope: No changes to sources, conditions, steps, evaluation outcomes, loss weighting, sample selection or budgets; no outcome-driven tuning.
